change.title: Rate-limit authenticated requests per client
change.summary: Adds a token-bucket rate limiter that runs on every authenticated request, sized by the client's plan. It replaces the ad-hoc five-orders-per-minute throttle that lived inside createOrder. Time comes from an injectable Clock so the limiter can be tested.
change.head: after

members.name: buildServer
members.klar:
~ fn buildServer(clock: Clock = systemClock) -> Router @ :8-16
    "Wire the router: authentication, then rate limiting, then the order routes."
    let router = new Router
+   let limiter = new RateLimiter(clock)
    router.use(auth.requireAuth)
+   router.use(limits.rateLimit(limiter))
    router.get("/orders", orders.listOrders)
    router.post("/orders", orders.createOrder)
    return router
    effects: none

members.name: bucketFor
members.signature: (clientId: Text, plan: Plan, now: Time) -> TokenBucket
members.klar:
private fn bucketFor(clientId: Text, plan: Plan, now: Time) -> TokenBucket @ :21-29
    "Find the client's bucket, creating a full one from their plan's limits the first time."
    if buckets has no entry for clientId
      let { burst, perSecond } = config.LIMITS[plan]
      set buckets[clientId] = new TokenBucket(burst, perSecond, now)
    return buckets[clientId]
    effects: mutates buckets
members.summary: Find the client's bucket, creating a full one from their plan's limits the first time.

components.name: TokenBucket

members.name: refill
members.klar:
fn refill(now: Time) @ :10-14
    "Add the tokens earned since the last refill, never exceeding capacity."
    set tokens = min(capacity, tokens + seconds since updatedAt × refillPerSecond)
    set updatedAt = now
    effects: mutates self
members.summary: Add the tokens earned since the last refill, never exceeding capacity.

members.name: tryTake
members.klar:
fn tryTake() -> Bool @ :16-20
    "Take one token if there is a whole one left."
    if tokens < 1
      return false
    set tokens = tokens - 1
    return true
    effects: mutates self
members.summary: Take one token if there is a whole one left.

members.name: secondsUntilNext
members.klar:
fn secondsUntilNext() -> Num @ :22-24
    "How long until a whole token is available; zero if one already is."
    if tokens ≥ 1
      return 0
    return (1 - tokens) / refillPerSecond
    effects: none
members.summary: How long until a whole token is available; zero if one already is.

components.summary: An allowance that holds up to capacity tokens and regains refillPerSecond every second.

flows.name: A request passes through the limiter
flows.description: Every authenticated request now spends one token before it reaches its route. An empty bucket ends the request with 429 and a retry-after header.

flows.name: Server start-up wiring
flows.description: buildServer creates one RateLimiter for the process and installs its middleware directly after authentication.

notes.text: Buckets are never evicted. Memory grows with every distinct client the process has ever seen.
Order creation is no longer capped at 5 per minute. It now shares the general allowance, so a free user can place 20 orders at once and then about 60 a minute.
The limiter runs after requireAuth, so unauthenticated requests are not limited at all.
Limits are held in process memory, so each server instance counts separately.
